bellows/data-volume.key: replace with the output of: openssl rand -base64 32

bellows/wallet.secret: replace with the output of: openssl rand -hex 32

bellows/admin.token_hash: replace with the sha256 hex of your admin token

bellows/suppliers.tinfoil: replace with your Tinfoil API key
bellows/suppliers.tokenfactory: replace with your Token Factory API key

bellows/announcement.event: replace with the JSON text that pnpm announce --out writes

bellows/onion-volume.key: replace with the output of: openssl rand -base64 32
